onboarding.fingerprint.lead: A cryptographic identifier unique to this device. When connecting from another device, this fingerprint will appear on the other end for visual verification.
onboarding.fingerprint.hint: Always visually verify this fingerprint when pairing. A mismatch may indicate a man-in-the-middle attack.

onboarding.ready.title: All set
onboarding.ready.lead: Try connecting. Switch features any time from the top menu.
